snippet.title: Create Your Community Card Game on Twitch | GhoulxCards Streamer Trailer
snippet.description:
Give your Twitch chat its own card game. GhoulxCards turns your community into collectors, deckbuilders and raid parties, with a card set that belongs to your channel.

Apply for your channel: https://cards.ghoulxghoul.com/apply

What streamers get:
- Live raids: the whole chat vs one boss, live on your stream. Viewers show up early to join.
- Boss drops: the Twitch CEO's cowboy hat, plus 3 packs (one a Rare Booster) for everyone who played
- Post-raid recaps with awards: MVP, Heartbreaker, Bug Squasher, Punching Bag... and First to Fall
- Packs every day for channel-point check-ins, bits and gift subs, so chat stays active (lurkers too)
- Select Adventure maps to challenge your community
- Design your own cards: pick a card, give it your name and your art. Same effect, so it stays fair, and it drops in your channel's packs
- Your own Tavern, where chat pops up over your viewers' heads
- Your own Tavern shop, a free pet code every day, and gift packs for giveaways

Watch us live on Twitch: https://twitch.tv/ghoulxghoul

Music: "8 Bit The Hero" by Sygil (CC0)
